description: Verifies the explicit-state PCG64 generator that underpins deterministic replay: reproducibility, stream independence, output ranges, Gaussian moments, jump-ahead and registry derived sub-engines.

checks.label: identical seed and stream produce identical sequences
different streams do not produce coinciding values
the sample mean of the standard normal distribution is close to zero
the sample variance of the standard normal distribution is close to one
step_forward equals the same number of sequential draws
distinct sub-engine identifiers give distinct streams
the same registry seed and identifier reproduce the same sub-engine
